description: This file defines template structures and functions for atomic operations tailored for different data types, including float, int, half, short, char, uchar, bfloat, bool, half2, long, and float2, specifically optimized for Metal API. It provides atomic add implementations and handles special cases where atomic operations are not natively supported.
